verdicts.reason: A blows the small cross icon up into a huge, blurry, pixelated block that takes over the middle of the skyscraper. It is now the main focal point, and the lines break badly ('LIAM / DRAKE', a lone 'LIVONIA'), with the dates left-aligned and ragged under a centred stack. B keeps the cross at its proper size, but the dates and 'WORSHIP & BIBLE STUDY' drift off the centre axis. It also wraps into choppy lines ('SPEND THIS / SUMMER IN / LIVONIA'), leaves a large dead gap above the hiker, and shrinks the illustration to a tiny strip at the bottom.
